scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
In this highly competitive society, we must be different in order to survive!
I only refine equipment at the +6 ~ 12 levels.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
在这个竞争激烈的社会，我们必须与众不同才能生存！
我只负责+6到+12的装备强化。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
I will need ^ff9999Blessed Oridecon^000000 for weapons, and ^ff9999Blessed Elunium^000000 for armors.
Failed refines ^FF0000will not break or reduce the refine level^000000.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
强化武器需要^ff9999受祝福的武器矿石^000000，强化防具需要^ff9999受祝福的防具矿石^000000。
强化失败^FF0000不会损坏装备或降低强化等级^000000。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
How about it? Do you want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
怎么样？你想强化吗？

scripts.text: [Blacksmith Dister]
scripts.translation: [铁匠 迪斯特]

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
I'm a blacksmith, not a hairstylist.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
我是铁匠，不是理发师。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
With my hammer, I will make you a star of the sky.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
用我的锤子，我会让你成为天空中的明星。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Making artificial hands is not my specialty.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
制作假手不是我的专长。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Bring out the item so I can refine it!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
把要强化的物品拿出来吧！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Where is this weird smell coming from?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
这股奇怪的味道是从哪里来的？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Where is the accessory?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
饰品在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
What do you want me to refine?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
你想让我强化什么？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Huh? What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
嗯？你想让我做什么？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
This item cannot be refined.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
这个物品无法强化。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
This equipment has refined to {0}. I only handle items with refine levels from +6 to +12!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
这件装备已经强化到{0}了。我只负责强化等级在+6到+12之间的物品！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
This {0} has been refined to {1}. To refine it, I need {2} and a {3} zeny refining fee.
Do you want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
这件{0}已经强化到{1}了。强化它需要{2}和{3} Zeny的强化费。
你确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
I am busy, don't joke with me!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
我很忙，别跟我开玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
This {0} has been refined many times. Although it will not disappear upon failure, the {1} will disappear!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
这件{0}已经强化过很多次了。虽然失败不会消失，但{1}会消失！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Of course, the refining fee will not be returned! Do you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
当然，强化费是不会退还的！你确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Good. I'd be sad if it failed, too.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
很好。如果失败了，我也会很难过的。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Materials insufficient.
To refine a level {0} {1}, I need {2} and a {3} zeny refining fee.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
材料不足。
强化等级为{0}的{1}，需要{2}和{3} Zeny的强化费。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Tac! Tac! Tac!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
叮！叮！叮！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Hahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Refine was a huge success~ Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
强化大成功~ 哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Oh my goodness!!!!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
天哪！！！！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Oh! Although it was blessed by {0} to retain the equipment...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
哎呀！虽然被{0}祝福保留了装备...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
My mood is worse when I fail!!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠 迪斯特]
失败的时候心情更糟糕了！！
